Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.4: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) with Decompression (Indirect or Direct)

Required findings: The prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion was performed at least 6 months prior to the current request.
Criteria have been met in the applicable procedure-specific section: CMM-609.4 (Lumbar Fusion with Decompression) OR CMM-609.5 (Lumbar Fusion without Decompression).

If CMM-609.4 applies: The individual is a candidate for lumbar decompression or lumbar corpectomy per CMM-608, and imaging findings include specific instability (e.g., degenerative spondylolisthesis with dynamic instability >3mm or Meyerding Grade II+; spondylolisthesis with spondylolysis with progression or Grade III+; or iatrogenic instability from facet excision >50% bilateral/75% single), OR anticipated iatrogenic instability, OR adult symptomatic degenerative spinal deformity (Cobb >30°, sagittal axis >8cm, PI-LL >15°), OR specific disc herniation scenarios (extraforaminal L5-S1, foraminal requiring facet resection, or low-lying conus).

If CMM-609.5 applies: Imaging findings include specific spondylolisthesis criteria (dynamic instability >3mm or Meyerding Grade II+ for degenerative; progression or Grade III+ for isthmic), OR moderate to severe single-level disc degeneration with chronic pain for at least one year, OR adult symptomatic degenerative spinal deformity.

Documentation of nicotine-free status: Individual is a never-smoker OR has refrained from smoking, smokeless tobacco, and nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery, validated by objective cotinine testing (serum, urinary, or saliva) within normal range.

Non-Indications: Lumbar fusion for adjacent segment disease where the prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion was performed less than 6 months prior.
Cases where the criteria for the specific underlying pathology (decompression or non-decompression) are not met, such as absence of required objective imaging findings for instability or deformity.
Patients who have not demonstrated nicotine-free status for at least 6 weeks prior to surgery or who fail objective cotinine testing.

Patients with unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders) when applying CMM-609.5 criteria.
Important criteria & exceptions: For Actual Instability under CMM-609.4: When instability is created and/or identified intra-operatively, the pre-operative imaging criteria for instability are NOT required.

For CMM-609.5 (Discogenic Lower Back Pain): Requires structured physician-supervised, multi-modal, nonoperative management including regularly scheduled appointments and follow-up evaluation, with less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the specified conservative therapies for at least 12 consecutive months.

For CMM-609.5 (Spondylolisthesis/Deformity): Requires less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER prescription analgesics/NSAIDs OR provider-directed exercise program for at least three (3) consecutive months.
Documentation required: Documentation of the date of the prior adjacent-level lumbar fusion to verify the 6-month interval.
Objective cotinine testing results (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab, or documentation of never-smoker status.

Imaging reports (plain x-rays, flexion-extension views, CT, or MRI) demonstrating the specific instability, deformity, or disc degeneration criteria required by the applicable CMM-609.4 or CMM-609.5 section.
Records of conservative management trials (prescription medication logs, physical therapy notes, injection records) to verify the required duration and lack of clinically meaningful improvement.
Documentation of the absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders.
